crossRefs.note: For Yahweh said to me, “I will be still, and I will see in my dwelling place, like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud…
Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.
Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.
He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they do? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here…
The glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherub, whereupon it was, to the threshold of the house; and he called…
Now the cherubim stood on the right side of the house, when the man went in; and the cloud filled the inner court.
Yahweh’s glory went out from over the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubim.
The cherubim lifted up their wings, and mounted up from the earth in my sight when they went out, with the wheels…
For I will be to Ephraim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Judah. I myself will tear in pieces and go…
I will go and return to my place, until they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face. In their affliction they will…
For, behold, Yahweh comes out of his place, and will come down and tread on the high places of the earth.
and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels…
About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his…
to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an…
Yahweh said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.
Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
“ ‘You shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land…
“ ‘So you shall not pollute the land where you live; for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the…
“Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.
“ ‘ “For her blood is in the middle of her. She set it on the bare rock. She didn’t pour it on the ground, to cover it…
That it may cause wrath to come up to take vengeance, I have set her blood on the bare rock, that it should not be…
You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?
When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God…
For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”
In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.”

translations.web: For, behold, Yahweh comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth also will disclose her blood, and will no longer cover her slain.
translations.bsb: For behold, the LORD is coming out of His dwelling to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity. The earth will reveal her bloodshed and will no longer conceal her slain.
translations.kjv: For, behold, the LORD cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
translations.asv: For, behold, Jehovah cometh forth out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
